title: apricity-daw midi.rs: a dependency-free Standard MIDI File writer
description:
## Intent

A small, dependency-free Standard MIDI File writer.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/midi.rs`: type 0, 960 ticks per quarter note, a tempo meta event, a time signature meta event, a track name, note on/off pairs sorted by time (note-off before note-on at the same tick), end of track. Beats convert to ticks by rounding to the nearest tick.
- No new crate dependency unless a review finds one clearly better (record the decision in a comment).
- Unit tests: byte-level golden test of a two-note file; a round trip through a reader written in the test.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw midi
```

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): write Standard MIDI Files`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the specs task. If the owner picks a MIDI clip file (`.alc`) in M0, this task writes that instead, using the sidecar initiative's clip writer.
